title: Simulating Misinformation Propagation in Social Networks using Large Language Models
findings: The persona of a 'Conservative Religious Leader' (Agent #18) acted as a significant misinformation accelerator, ranking as the second-worst offender among 21 personas. This persona produced extreme factual drift, escalating content to 'propaganda-level' distortion, especially on politically and morally charged topics. The study found this agent was a primary driver of political propaganda in the simulations.
